The '''blaststick''' was a [[Tasari]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] explosive manufactured by [[TasCorp]]. Typically sold in batches of ten, the blaststicks were harmless until connected to the [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]] by electrical wires. However, they could be triggered by a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt fired by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] even when not connected to a detonator.<ref name="J15" />
